content.short: Oobit is a Tether-backed app for paying with crypto in stores and online, straight from your wallet.
content.description: Oobit lets people pay with crypto and stablecoins wherever cards are accepted, online, in store or through local payment methods, and send money abroad. Backed by Tether, its mobile app has tens of thousands of reviews. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists Oobit.
content.meta: Oobit is a Tether-backed app for spending crypto in stores and online, listed in the Plasma ecosystem.
